info.name: Gets detailed information about a given build

items.docs:
Example:

    GET /builds/v1/build-operations/be77b25f-c738-462f-8f19-7114fc4f9923

You need the **Asset management > Open** permission.

info.name: Gets messages logged by a given build

items.docs:
Example:

    GET /builds/v1/build-operations/be77b25f-c738-462f-8f19-7114fc4f9923/log-messages

You need the **Asset management > Open** permission.

info.name: Gets generated code produced by a given build

items.docs:
This resource is only available after calling POST /build-operations/{operationKey}/generated-code with the respective build key.

            

 Example:

     GET /builds/v1/build-operations/be77b25f-c738-462f-8f19-7114fc4f9923/generated-code

You need the **Asset management > Open** permission.

info.name: Starts packaging the code generated for a given build

items.docs:
Example:

    POST /builds/v1/build-operations/be77b25f-c738-462f-8f19-7114fc4f9923/generated-code

You need the **Asset management > Open** permission.

info.name: List all builds created for a given revision of a given asset

params.name: assetRevision
params.description: The id of the revision of the asset

params.name: byBuildType
params.description: Filter by build type. Default: returns all

items.docs:
Example:

    GET /builds/v1/build-operations?assetKey=68ef84e5-9265-47b8-8612-b073b70e3e3e&assetRevision=1

You need the **Asset management > Open** permission.

info.name: Starts a job operation that will build a particular revision of a given asset

items.docs:
Example:

    POST /builds/v1/build-operations

    {

       "buildType": "Release",

       "assetKey": "68ef84e5-9265-47b8-8612-b073b70e3e3e",

       "assetRevision": 1

    }

You need the **Asset management > Open** permission.
